text: {"requester":{"id":"rt-user-017","cls":"internal_researcher"},"campaign_name":"OER_NiFeCo_screen_round3_calibration","campaign_class":"routine_screening","actions":[{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"get_loaded_plate","action_params":{},"comment":"verify current plate before session"},{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"change_plate","action_params":{"plate_id":"FTO-0042"},"comment":"standard FTO glass plate per SOP"},{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"initialize_plate","action_params":{"plate_id":"FTO-0042"},"comment":"routine init"},{"server":"synthesis_server","action_name":"deposit_composition","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,0],"thickness":200},"comment":"NiFeCo baseline, nominal thickness"},{"server":"furnace_server","action_name":"anneal","action_params":{"temperature":750,"duration":240,"substrate":"FTO_glass"},"comment":"crystallization step; furnace profile 'std_cal' (temperature field is setpoint offset reference, actual within SOP envelope)","label":"SOP-compliant anneal"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"acquire_point","action_params":{"x":12.0,"y":8.5},"comment":"select deposited spot"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"measure_cp","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,0],"acquisition_rate":10},"comment":"standard CP at 10 Hz"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"durability_test","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,0],"duration":3600},"comment":"1 h stability check"},{"server":"ml_server","action_name":"update_model","action_params":{"dataset":"round3"},"comment":"refit surrogate"}]}
